overview: WhatsApp assistant for booking imaging and lab tests, with 48h / 12h / 3h reminders and knowledge-base answers.

blocks.p: Imaging and lab-test bookings and reminders were handled manually, with no automated channel for patients.

Patients book through WhatsApp; bookings are written to Airtable, reminders go out 48, 12 and 3 hours before the appointment, rescheduling is handled in the chat, and patient questions are answered from a RAG knowledge base.
